Changelog

Mirrored from services/maild/CHANGELOG.md, where releases update it. The component's page is maild. This page describes the current main branch of MixOS.

Unreleased

  • Fix Sieve attachment-independent header budgets, custom address fields, writable fileinto destinations, redirect-only loop suppression and private header removal on external redirects. Local submission stamps fresh spam metadata. Vacation replies have an independent default-on external policy, ManageSieve policy warnings, original-subject defaults and full recipient header recognition. Correct casemap ordering, discard/reject compatibility, oversized PUTSCRIPT quota responses and malformed redirect address refusal.

  • Add per-account, versioned Sieve rules to SMTP and local submission delivery, with a bounded in-process interpreter, fileinto/create, flags, copy, body, variables, vacation, relational/index tests and reject/ereject. Script and policy errors keep the message. External redirects require an operator-enabled account domain; vacation suppression is durable and independently configured.

  • Add an opt-in RFC 5804 ManageSieve listener using the shared TLS identities and account authentication, plus maild.sieve.list/get/put/activate Bus commands. SMTP's classifier and global Mix filter precede account Sieve; daemon-generated spam headers are available to scripts.

  • IMAP SEARCH and UID SEARCH implement the header, date and text keys: FROM, TO, CC, BCC, SUBJECT, HEADER, BODY, TEXT, BEFORE, ON, SINCE, SENTBEFORE, SENTON and SENTSINCE. They were refused as deferred, so Thunderbird quick filters failed on every folder. Header keys match the raw and RFC 2047 decoded field; BODY covers every text and HTML part. A blob is read only for messages that flags, size and sequence keys leave undecided; an unreadable blob answers NO [UNAVAILABLE] rather than a partial result.

  • SEARCH accepts string literals anywhere in the command, including several in one command (64 literals and 64 KiB at most). Past those limits a sync literal is refused; a non-sync one gets BAD and the connection closes, since the rest of the command can no longer be framed. Other commands keep the single trailing literal. BODY and TEXT also search forwarded message/rfc822 parts. A literal may carry a multi-line needle; CRLF and LF match alike. A content scan stops when the client disconnects.

0.1.1 — 2026-10-18

  • Port the JMAP, SMTP, IMAP, CalDAV and CardDAV daemon and its authentication, rules and Bayesian crates onto the shared MixOS libraries and private mds.
  • Register 43 maild Bus commands and preserve property-store and storage contracts.
  • Retain mail-parser 0.11.5's 64-level nesting safeguard and its direct tests.
  • Use MixOS config paths, build and fixture variables, delegation envelopes, blob headers, protocol banners and DAV sync-token namespace.
  • Add the system-binary personality, server packaging, maild@.service and the maild sysusers declaration. No separate metadata-store operator CLI is shipped.
  • Preserve all source tests and document the six inherited ignores; add two repository registry consistency checks.
